reviews.comment: Take her for GEOL 101!  Easiest class ever - lectures are optional and practice tests have 90% of the questions word for word on the test itself.  I rarely went to class and made high Bs and As on all of the tests.  Super easy.

The tests were 90% copy and pasted from the practice quizzes she provides. The lectures were basically just her talking from the slide show so I stopped going to class after the first month and got a high A on both of the "midterm" tests. She does seem really sweet and she wants everyone to get a good grade.

This is the easiest class. Attendance is only mandatory for two lectures on the "in-class activities" days. She only assigns homework when she cancels lectures. Her exams very closely resemble the multiple-choice practice exam that she hands out with its answer key a week before the test. She sets her students up for success. DONT BUY TEXTBOOK.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the easiest class ever. I could not understand a word she said due to her accent, but she provided "test reviews" for every test. I do not care about geology at all, and will not remember a thing and I got an A. She is definitely the easiest Geol 101 prof. TAKE THIS CLASS!

Really great professor. Has a thick accent but you can understand her clearly after the first week. Very friendly and tries her hardest to make an otherwise mundane class very fun. You will read a LOT or scientific literature, and then use scientific literature techniques to write new papers. Gives really great feedback to help you understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She has a very thick accent, but her slides provide you with everything you need for her exams. Exams aren't too bad in my opinion. Attendance is not mandatory, however she does give out in class assignments which count towards your grade. Homework can be lengthy at times but is very simple, just do it. (Do exam practice problems!)
Very strong accent, hard to understand
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Good prof. The accent may be difficult to catch on right away, but she gives you all the info you need to do good. However, she did have a phrase that was used in a similar fashion to "like", trust me YOU'll KNOW when she uses it.

Class is relatively easy if you put in a little effort.  She is from Japan so at times she is tough to understand, but she is very nice and will help with any questions you might have.  She periodically hands out in class assignments that eventually account for like 12% of your grade so be weary to skip often.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You can tell she is only here for the research she can do at A&M. She will be gone for half the semester and when she is here she doesn't teach she reads out of the textbook. The only reason you have to go to class is because she randomly gives out in class activities for a grade. Other than that you could stay home read the book and do just fine
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
